nodes.text: Welcome to the warranty desk. I can help with a refund, exchange, or specialist handoff.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: Please confirm the order number and whether the package has been opened.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: I can keep the case open if you have a receipt email or shipping label photo.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: Receipt matched. The order is now attached to this case.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: This order qualifies for an immediate return label and refund review.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: I am sorry the item arrived damaged. I need a quick condition check before I proceed.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: Please upload clear photos within 48 hours so the claim stays in the fast lane.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: The photos confirm transit damage and waive the normal return shipping step.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: Unsafe-item reports bypass automation and go straight to a human safety specialist.
nodes.speaker: Routing

nodes.text: I can check stock, review exchange fees, or route a warranty defect to manual review.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: The preferred replacement can be reserved if inventory is available when the request is confirmed.
nodes.speaker: WarehouseAgent

nodes.text: Open-box exchanges may include a restocking fee unless a specialist overrides it.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: Before I escalate a warranty defect, please confirm whether the reset checklist fixed the issue.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

nodes.text: Standard refunds have expired, but some orders can still receive store credit or a manual exception review.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: I am transferring this case with the order notes and chat transcript attached.
nodes.speaker: Routing

nodes.text: A returns specialist will reply within two business hours with the next steps.
nodes.speaker: ReturnsLead

nodes.text: Refund approved. The payment reversal starts after the carrier scans the return label.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: Store credit approved. The credit memo will arrive by email once the case is closed.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: Exchange order created. A replacement confirmation and return instructions are on the way.
nodes.speaker: WarehouseAgent

nodes.text: I cannot approve this request automatically without the required policy checks.
nodes.speaker: PolicyBot

nodes.text: Case closed without shipment or refund. You can reopen it later if new documents arrive.
nodes.speaker: Assistant

edges.text: 1. Request a refund for a sealed order.
2. Report a damaged delivery.
3. Ask for an exchange.
4. Speak to a returns specialist now.
1. [Within 30 Days] Order is confirmed and the package is still sealed.
2. I cannot find the order number yet.
3. The order was delivered more than 30 days ago.
4. This is a billing or payment dispute.
1. Upload the receipt email now.
2. Continue without proof of purchase.
3. I want a person to review the account.
1. Refund the original payment method.
2. Convert this into an exchange instead.
3. Accept store credit with a bonus voucher.
1. [Photo Attached] I have box and product photos ready.
2. The item is leaking, sparking, or unsafe to touch.
3. I do not have photos yet.
1. I will send the photos now.
2. I cannot provide photos.
3. Cancel the damage claim.
1. Ship a replacement immediately.
2. Refund me instead of replacing it.
3. Arrange a specialist callback.
1. [Unopened] I need a different size or color.
2. The box was opened, but the item was never used.
3. The item was used and is now failing under warranty.
4. I would rather take a refund.
1. Reserve the in-stock replacement.
2. The preferred model is out of stock, so offer store credit.
3. I need help choosing an equivalent item.
1. Accept the fee and create the exchange.
2. Ask a supervisor to waive the fee.
3. Cancel this exchange request.
1. [Reset Completed] The device works after troubleshooting.
2. The device still fails after troubleshooting.
3. The serial label is missing.
1. Accept store credit instead of a refund.
2. Request a manual exception review.
3. Close the case with no action.
